building: Ray W. Herrick Laboratories (2013 HLAB building)

criteria.name: Identity, GIS footprint, and plan
criteria.evidence: 58-point raised foundation loop has 0.197 m maximum symmetric vertex-to-segment distance from raw Purdue FID 878 coordinates under the documented local conversion; 5.025 m2 area difference, about 0.19%. This is the same GIS feature used to author the candidate, not an independent wall survey.

criteria.name: Local frame and placement basis
criteria.evidence: Candidate geometry uses a local frame and documented campus origin; south-facing entry agrees with current Purdue visitor information. Master Placement marker and campus neighborhood were not checked in this standalone grade.

criteria.name: Exterior form and roof
criteria.evidence: Three-storey office/lab, glazed living-lab wing, and dark high-bay are recognizable. Roof remains a broad flat cap without the articulated high-level glazed/steel monitor/canopy cue in the Purdue design elevations and 2013 image; roof equipment is schematic.

criteria.name: Facade, entrance, and materials
criteria.evidence: Brick piers, pale metal spandrels, dark high-bay face, framed glazing, and south entry distinguish the main material zones with procedural materials. Window rhythm, facade modules, entry/canopy, and planting remain simplified.

criteria.name: Interior and laboratory use
criteria.evidence: Three schematic floor plates, connected corridor/stair/elevator cues, partitions, work surfaces, and lab/test-rig silhouettes are present. Floor diagrams support broad use zones but not exact room/equipment placement; no supplied interior cutaway render.

criteria.name: Saved asset, evidence, and portability
criteria.evidence: Exact candidate hash reopened in Blender 5.2.3; 80 asset objects, 68 meshes, 17 used materials, no materialless meshes, invalid material references, external images, or linked libraries. The four preview-stage objects are outside the building collection. No dedicated root object; master marker must be checked at integration.

source_identity.provider: Purdue University Campus BuildingShapesZip4 ArcGIS FeatureServer layer 0

footprint_comparison.method: Transform raw GIS ring with project local-meter conversion and subtract documented campus placement origin; compare to 58-point candidate raised-foundation bottom loop using symmetric vertex-to-segment distance.
footprint_comparison.limitation: Candidate was authored from the same GIS ring; this is not independent survey evidence.

limitations: Roof monitor/clerestory form, parapet and equipment are simplified or uncertain.
Window sizes and exact facade modules are estimated from undimensioned photos/design elevations.
Interior partitions, vertical circulation and lab equipment placement are schematic, not as-built verified.
Master placement marker and neighborhood context have not been checked.
GIS outline is approximate campus GIS, the same footprint used to author the candidate; no independent structural-wall survey was available.
